user_story: As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I enter a todo in the input field with aria-label 'New Todo Input' and press enter, the todo should appear in the list. 2. When I click the checkbox with id 'toggle-all', all todos should be marked as completed. 3. When I click the button with class 'clear-completed', all completed todos should be removed from the list.
